calls.statement:
WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at, f.channel_code
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id LIMIT 12

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id||'-'||f.line_no) dl, sum(f.net_amount) net, 
 sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_net, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) ndays, min(f.sale_date) d0, max(f.sale_date) d1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY net DESC

WITH s AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_dedup, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE f.net_amount END) nonstaff
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, line_no, sale_date, store_key, product_key, quantity, net_amount, staff_purchase_flag FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21') f
 JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(rl.refund_net) ret, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT rl.return_line_id) nd
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=rl.store_key
 WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
p AS (SELECT store_id, sum(receipts) rc, sum(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, sum(returns_net) rn, sum(net_sales) ns, count(*) nd FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.store_id, s.gross_dedup, s.nonstaff, r.ret, r.n, r.nd, p.nsbr, p.rn, p.ns, p.nd
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING (store_id) FULL JOIN p USING (store_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT period_start_date d0, period_end_date d1 FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=5),
sales AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT receipt_id, line_no, sale_date, store_key, product_key, quantity, net_amount FROM fact_sales_line, p WHERE sale_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1) f
 JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2),
rets AS (
 SELECT st.store_id, sum(rl.refund_net) refunds
 FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=rl.store_key, p
 WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN p.d0 AND p.d1 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.gross_net - coalesce(r.refunds,0) DESC) AS rank, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.gross_net - coalesce(r.refunds,0) AS net_sales
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (store_id) ORDER BY rank
